primary_goal: Guide mobile visitors into brand shops, product categories, or specific product detail pages to initiate browsing and purchasing journeys.

friction_points.issue: Absence of core German-market trust indicators, shipping guarantees, and risk-reversal signals in the viewport.
friction_points.evidence: Neither the header nor the visible feed sections display service guarantees such as 100-day free returns (100 Tage Rückgaberecht), free delivery, or accepted payment methods like Kauf auf Rechnung or PayPal.

friction_points.issue: Repetitive brand-first feed layout forces excessive scrolling without structured category entry points.
friction_points.evidence: The feed stacks repetitive brand blocks (Khujo, Vans, HUGO, Columbia) each showing only a hero image, a text snippet, a generic pill button ('Discover the brand', 'Shop now'), and 2 narrow product cards, with no horizontal quick-filters for categories (e.g., Men, Women, Shoes, Jackets, Sale).

friction_points.issue: Intrusive interstitial promotional banner disrupts shopping flow without a clear action or value proposition.
friction_points.evidence: A full-width grey-and-pink container titled 'Match, swipe, play: ...' with four abstract line icons (play, coil, phone with heart, smile) has an 'X' close icon but no distinct primary CTA button explaining the tangible user benefit.

friction_points.issue: Weak visual hierarchy and low touch-target contrast for product actions within cards.
friction_points.evidence: Product tiles underneath Khujo, Vans, and Columbia have tiny text for prices, low-contrast secondary buttons ('Add to bag' / variation pills), and small wishlist heart icons overlaying image backgrounds.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we introduce a compact USP banner directly below the search bar highlighting free delivery, 100-day returns, and purchase on invoice (Rechnung), then click-through rate to product pages will increase because German consumers' transactional risk hesitation is immediately reduced.
hypotheses.change: Add a sticky or top-of-feed rotating/static micro-USP bar (e.g., 'Kostenloser Versand & Rückversand | Kauf auf Rechnung').

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add horizontal category quick-links (e.g., 'Jackets', 'Sneakers', 'Sale', 'New In') above the brand feed, then browse depth and add-to-cart rate will improve because shoppers can reach their specific intent without scrolling past multiple full-screen brand campaigns.
hypotheses.change: Place horizontally scrollable category chips directly below the top search header.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the vague 'Match, swipe, play' promo banner with a clear incentivized CTA card (e.g., 'Exclusive app discounts'), then engagement will increase and banner dismissals will decrease because the visitor receives an explicit, valuable reason to interact.
hypotheses.change: Add explicit benefit copy and a prominent primary CTA button instead of a passive graphic with an 'X' close button.

quick_wins: Increase contrast and tap area for the wishlist heart icons on all product tiles.
Add a high-contrast primary CTA button (e.g., 'Play now' or 'Try it') inside the 'Match, swipe, play' banner.
Increase font size and background contrast for discount percentage callouts (such as the red '-35%' badge on the Vans product card).
uncertainties: Whether this view is within the native Zalando mobile application or a mobile browser session.
Whether the displayed brands and items are personalized based on prior user behavior or globally served to all new visitors.
Whether the English-language copy is an intentional user setting or default fallback for a non-German locale setting.
